prompts: I want to share an X/Twitter link to a Telegram bot and have it parsed like a web clipper into my synced Obsidian vault.
Design my personal-gateway so today it captures links and quick notes, but later it can accept budgeting, finance, attendance, and daily-log inputs without becoming a mess.
My Telegram bot sometimes receives the same webhook twice. Make vault writes idempotent and preserve the original message for recovery.
